name: pyfmi-distributed
description: Realtime FMI runtime and protocol adapters generated from SysML v2.

hla.description: IEEE 1516 HLA adapter (OpenRTI is fetched, not a vcpkg port)

dcp.description: ASAM X-DCP adapter (DCPLib is fetched; its dependencies come from vcpkg)

ros2.description: ROS 2 adapter (consumed from a system Jazzy installation, not from vcpkg)

ed247.description: ED-247 adapter (Airbus ED247_LIBRARY is fetched; LibXml2 comes from vcpkg)
